literal_meaning: একবার বলার মাত্রেই (upon saying just once)
similar_in_english: at the drop of a hat
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একবার বলামাত্র কাজ শুরু করে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He started the work as soon as I mentioned it once.
The child came running immediately upon hearing the call.
note: This idiom emphasizes quick and unquestioning response, common in Bengali oral traditions.
